scope: Only the exact 93 IDs in the released block assignment: frozen titles and complete ItemBodies, matching current source/snapshot and local HTML, receipt metadata, and every receipt-listed tile. Local-only; no live routes.
attribution: Actual image views and source/body review recorded here belong to helper lane 02. No lane09 view is claimed.

review_method.instructions: CLAUDE.md and local audit workflow read before review.
review_method.source_snapshot_html: For every assigned item, frozen title and complete ItemBody were reviewed across its full rendered tile sequence and compared with its matching local HTML. Source, snapshot, and HTML hashes are recorded per item.
review_method.rendering: Every receipt-listed PNG tile was individually opened with tools.view_image at original resolution; no collage or resized substitute.
review_method.boundaries: No production/source item/app edits, publication changes, live website, or network access.

findings.rationale: The constructive proof is geometric throughout: it chooses a projection direction, decomposes the polygon into vertical slabs and bands between affine boundary graphs, refines shared walls, then triangulates each convex cell by a fan from an interior point. A single schematic could make the slab decomposition, wall refinement, and compatibility of adjacent fans visible; the proof itself is complete without it. This meets the high-likelihood threshold because the geometric subdivisions and shared-face condition carry the construction.

concrete_maps_and_relations.projection: Choose e so the finitely many vertex projections <v_i,e> are distinct; use coordinates parallel and perpendicular to e.
concrete_maps_and_relations.slab_bands: Between consecutive vertex projections, the polygon portion is a finite union of closed bands between vertically ordered affine boundary graphs.
concrete_maps_and_relations.wall_refinement: Insert all band-boundary/wall intersections and take a common finite refinement on each vertical wall; neighboring cells then share full refined segments.
concrete_maps_and_relations.triangulation_fans: Choose an interior point in each convex triangular or quadrilateral cell and join it cyclically to boundary vertices; the resulting fan triangles cover each cell and agree across refined shared walls.

note: No confirmed LaTeX/TikZ rendering defects. One high-likelihood missing-diagram candidate is reported for thm-simple-polygon-admits-a-triangulation; optional diagrams are not otherwise elevated.
